description.en: A water-based coating prepared for an even residential finish. The performance level identifies where it works best and supports realistic coverage and budget comparisons. This listing is for greige acrylic paint for indoor walls, high coverage for renovation coats.

Este anúncio apresenta tinta acrílica greige para parede interna, alta cobertura para pintura de renovação.
